semantics.observer_role: Human count1 and FRA controller0, separately from physical UI ref
semantics.owner_snapshot_country_anchor: FRA is the observer identity; outer object and replay closure bind province ID
semantics.positive_admission: FRA self identity/admission and observer-slot province discovery bit is1 on both passes
semantics.clear_bit: unknown; selected fields are not read without positive discovery
semantics.value: Signed int32 at canonical province record+0x890, after native-manager bounds and alias/ID echo validation.
semantics.name_semantics: copied EU4Escape name cache, without owner-acceptance color prefix or full tooltip
semantics.religion_icon: signed i32 setter argument, not an actual rendered frame
semantics.autonomy: max(0,min(max(current,lower),upper)); integer percent thousandths; native clamp order preserved
semantics.development: effective component bases plus conditional owner tribal bonuses, truncation toward zero and signed-i32 wrap; total raw thousandths
semantics.resource: native key/icon plus cached name bytes; public literal name is not a rendered string
semantics.center: NULL ->presentFalse/level0; otherwise positive level plus kind and derived sprite key, no rendering claim
semantics.resource_name_encoding: explicit eu4_escape decoding; no codec inference or dynamic substitution
semantics.numeric_modifier_processor_policy: NULL only, guarded per read; no processor invocation
